info.name: FakeStoreAPI - Carts
info.description:
Коллекция запросов и тестов для API Carts (FakeStoreAPI: https://fakestoreapi.com/docs#tag/Carts).
Содержит проверки для GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE корзин, фильтрации по датам и пользователям.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response is an array of carts', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });

pm.test('Cart structure contains required fields', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); const cart = jsonData[0]; pm.expect(cart).to.have.property('id').that.is.a('number'); pm.expect(cart).to.have.property('userId').that.is.a('number'); pm.expect(cart).to.have.property('date').that.is.a('string'); pm.expect(cart).to.have.property('products').that.is.an('array'); });
pm.test('Response time is under 2000ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(2000); });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Cart ID matches requested ID', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.id).to.eql(parseInt(pm.variables.get('cartId'))); pm.expect(jsonData).to.have.property('userId'); pm.expect(jsonData).to.have.property('products').that.is.an('array'); });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Exactly 3 carts returned', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(jsonData.length).to.eql(3); });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Carts are sorted descending by ID', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.length).to.be.above(1); for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length - 1; i++) { pm.expect(jsonData[i].id).to.be.above(jsonData[i + 1].id); } });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Carts within date range returned', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; const start = new Date('2019-12-10'); const end = new Date('2020-10-10'); jsonData.forEach(cart => { const cartDate = new Date(cart.date); pm.expect(cartDate.getTime()).to.be.at.least(start.getTime()); pm.expect(cartDate.getTime()).to.be.at.most(end.getTime()); }); });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('All returned carts belong to target userId', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; const expectedUserId = parseInt(pm.variables.get('userId')); jsonData.forEach(cart => { pm.expect(cart.userId).to.eql(expectedUserId); }); });
pm.test('Status code is 200 or 201 Created', function () { pm.expect([200, 201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

pm.test('Response returns created cart with generated ID', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(jsonData.userId).to.eql(5); pm.expect(jsonData.products).to.be.an('array').with.lengthOf(2); });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Cart products replaced successfully', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.userId).to.eql(3); pm.expect(jsonData.products).to.be.an('array').with.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(jsonData.products[0].productId).to.eql(1); pm.expect(jsonData.products[0].quantity).to.eql(3); });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Updated userId returned', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData.userId).to.eql(4); });
pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Deleted cart returned', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(jsonData.id).to.eql(6); });

item.name: 11. GET User Carts for Non-existent User (Edge Case)

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Returns empty array for non-existent user carts', function () { const jsonData = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(jsonData).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty; });
